svg.title: Orthographic projection of the globe
svg.desc: Parallel rays, the visible hemisphere and the hidden test on the left; the foreshortened graticule on the right.
svg.text: Side view: the plane through the view axis
B: behind, inside the disc: hidden
C: behind the centre plane but
disc radius on screen = R * zoom * sqrt(3/2) pixels
The graticule seen from latitude 35.26 degrees
x = cos(phi) sin(dlam), y = cos(phi0) sin(phi) - sin(phi0) cos(phi) cos(dlam)
east-west spacing shrinks as cos(phi) sin(dlam) flattens at the limb
